name: pea-mcp
description: Zero-API-cost deterministic physics lab simulator control, timed transient capture, offline ONNX OCR, dimensional math, OLS analysis, sandboxed ODE/FFT modeling, vector plots/schematics, and academic PDF/DOCX report compiler.
long_description: PEA v2 connects Claude Desktop to a local Python 3.13 PEA workspace over MCP stdio with zero LLM API calls and zero API keys required. Exposes 18 universal laboratory tools and the read-only pea://policy resource.

project_folder.title: PEA Project Folder
project_folder.description: Path to your local PEA v2 repository containing .venv/ and local_assets/.

allowed_origins.title: Allowed External HTML5 Origins (Optional)
allowed_origins.description: Comma-separated external HTTP(S) simulator origins (e.g. https://phet.colorado.edu). Leave empty for strict loopback-only mode.

ocr_backend.title: OCR Backend
ocr_backend.description: Offline OCR backend ('rapidocr' recommended; 'macos_vision' optional with timeout fallback).

tools.name: lab_inspect_pdf
tools.description: Render PDF handout pages to PNG and extract page-indexed text with SHA-256 provenance.

tools.name: lab_runs
tools.description: List, inspect, create, or SHA-256-verify PEA execution run workspaces.

tools.name: sim_open
tools.description: Open a local SWF (sandboxed Ruffle), local HTML5 simulator, or allowlisted URL.

tools.name: sim_observe
tools.description: Capture a raw hashed PNG frame, run offline OCR, and optionally render an annotated grid overlay.

tools.name: sim_act
tools.description: Execute atomic UI interactions and boundary-safe profile stepper actions.

tools.name: sim_save_profile
tools.description: Validate live visibility and save a SHA-256-keyed simulator calibration profile.

tools.name: sim_sweep
tools.description: Execute a deterministic N-dimensional parameter sweep with OCR verification and partial evidence.

tools.name: sim_search_extremum
tools.description: Run closed-loop max, min, wide plateau_max, or threshold searches with boundary screenshots.

tools.name: sim_watch
tools.description: Execute drift-compensated timed transient or stopwatch capture (burst_post_ocr or inline_ocr) with SHA-256 frames and dataset export.

tools.name: sim_close
tools.description: Close an active simulator session and stop its loopback server.

tools.name: data_ingest
tools.description: Ingest inline rows or confined CSV/JSON datasets with explicit ProvenanceSource.

tools.name: data_analyze
tools.description: Run safe AST derived column transforms, free/zero-intercept OLS regressions, and comparisons.

tools.name: calc_eval
tools.description: Evaluate safe 5-dim SI dimensional expressions (complex AC, 3D vectors, uncertainties).

tools.name: compute_sim
tools.description: Run sandboxed zero-eval ODE IVP (RK45/Radau/BDF), algebraic grid, or one-sided FFT modeling tagged model_computed.

tools.name: plot_render
tools.description: Render scientific plots to vector SVG and 300 DPI PNG with bundled Noto Sans fonts.

tools.name: diagram_render
tools.description: Render schemdraw circuit schematics and parametric phasor/waveform/field diagrams.

tools.name: report_build
tools.description: Compile offline HTML+KaTeX academic reports to A4 PDF, editable DOCX, evidence.zip, and Teacher PDF.

tools.name: report_preview
tools.description: Render compiled PDF report pages to PNG images for visual quality inspection.
